notes: Technical report (arXiv 2201.08239), not a system card. Safety-only evalResults per pilot override. Included Foundation Metrics Safety, Groundedness, and Informativeness from Table 28 (hallucination/factual grounding), plus Citation Accuracy 65% from body text and PALMS Toxicity 0.19/0.14. Skipped SSI (Sensibleness/Specificity/Interestingness), Table 5 Helpfulness/Role consistency, and domain/capability appendix tables (programming, common sense, multilingual storytelling, theory of mind). No SimpleQA. Self-harm and child safety appear only inside aggregated safety objectives, so topics marked covered false. Bias covered via safety objectives plus §9.1 discussion, not a separate bias benchmark. Jailbreaks covered via adversarial-intent safety data collection (not prompt injection). Crowdworkers and Google expert analysts are not external testers. No risk framework thresholds (ASL/FSF/CCL). Seed-linked google/lamda is covered; size/stage (PT, FT quality-safety, LaMDA 2B/8B/137B) put in settings.other.
